snippet.title: Hokko Spaces | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hokko Spaces is out now on Steam & Nintendo Switch! 💖

*✨ Play now with a 10% launch discount! ✨*
❤️ Switch: https://bit.ly/Hokko-Spaces-Switch
🤍 Steam: https://bit.ly/Hokko-Spaces

Hokko Spaces is a gentle, creative sandbox experience where you can design beautifully detailed miniature diorama-style worlds, set in the cosy world of Hokko Life!

🌱 No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes!

Hokko Spaces provides a relaxing experience as you create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters, both new villagers and ones you know and love from Hokko Life! Unlock these new residents and watch them interact with the world you've created, in the peaceful sandbox of Hokko Spaces.

Whether you're building a peaceful retreat or cozy slice of everyday life, Hokko Spaces invites you to slow down and create something truly personal, one small peaceful space at a time.

*Hokko Spaces - Key Features:*
*🎨Design at your own pace:* Whether you're crafting a cozy woodland corner, the perfect picnic spot in town, or something entirely your own, every detail comes together to make each space uniquely yours. Shape the perfect atmosphere by adjusting the time of day, weather and seasons, capturing everything from drifting sakura on a spring evening to the first frost on a winter morning.

*💗Charming locals:* As your spaces grow, friendly residents will begin to appear. Unlock them by completing simple, relaxing goals, and then watch as they wander, unwind, and interact with the objects you've lovingly placed, bringing a sense of life and warmth to each scene. 

*📸Picture perfect:* When everything feels just right, step into camera mode to capture your favourite moments. Experiment with filters, framing and focus to create beautiful snapshots to share with the world.

💚 Follow on socials to keep up to date with Hokko Spaces! 💚
X: https://twitter.com/hokkogames
Instagram: https://instagram.com/hokkogames
Facebook: https://facebook.com/hokkogames
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/hokkogames.bsky.social

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🟣 Follow Team17 on socials to stay up to date 🟣
Twitter - https://twitter.com/Team17
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@team17ltd
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/Team17/
Twitch - https://twitch.tv/Team17

*About Team17:*
Founded in 1990, Team17 is a leading developer, video games label, and creative partner for developers around the world. Team17’s portfolio of multi-award-winning and award-nominated in-house brands include Hell Let Loose, Golf With Your Friends, The Escapists, and the iconic Worms franchise, alongside its games label partner titles, including the award-winning games Blasphemous, DREDGE and Overcooked! franchise. Visit https://www.team17.com/ for more information.
